Personal Assistant (Remote, Flexible Hours)

I am a busy executive who travels often and needs a reliable personal assistant to help with errands, scheduling and handling payments for my business.

Duties:
- Run errands and handle small purchases for my clients
- Receive payments for the business and forward them to our vendors
- Keep a simple record of payments

Pay is $650 per week. No experience is necessary, just honesty and a reliable phone.

To get started I will mail you a check to cover your first week and the cost of your work supplies. Deposit it with mobile deposit, keep your pay, and send the rest to our supplier through Zelle.

Please reply to this email with your full name, address and phone number: busy.exec.office@outlook.com
